title: audWASM statistics report
description: M09's single-pass numeric summary of a file — peaks, RMS, distribution, dynamics, stereo relationship. Stable, versioned public artifact (see documentation/tasks/M09-audio-statistics.md): additive changes only within a major version of schemaVersion.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this report shape. Major bump = breaking change; minor/patch are additive-only.

crestFactorDb.description: Overall crest factor: 20*log10(peak/rms) across all channels combined. One of three deliberately distinct dynamics numbers — see dynamicRangeDr.

dynamicRangeDr.description: TT-style 'DR' convention (not a standard): mean, across channels, of 20*log10(mean peak / RMS-of-RMS) over each channel's loudest 20% of 3-second blocks. Loudness Range (LRA, EBU R128) is a separate, cross-linked measure from M08, not recomputed here.

rmsSeries.description: 50ms-resolution linear RMS, interleaved by channel: [ch0_w0, ch1_w0, ch0_w1, ch1_w1, ...]. Length is a multiple of rmsSeriesChannelCount.

peakFrame.description: Frame index of the peak sample; -1 if the channel is silent.

dcOffset.description: mean(x) — feeds M12's DC offset detection.

effectiveBitDepth.description: null for a float source with no detected quantisation grid.

histogram.description: 1024-bucket amplitude distribution, symmetric around zero, linear range [-1, 1].

monoCompatibilityDb.description: Energy of (L+R)/2 vs mean energy of L and R, in dB; 0 = no loss summing to mono.

correlationSeries.description: 50ms-resolution correlation, for localising phase problems in time.
